runner_failure: Control repository must be clean before a qualifying run.
observed_sequence: fresh clone bound to exact R17 plan commit on named branch
manual git status --porcelain was empty before wrapper invocation
R17 wrapper parser-import regression path passed
R17 wrapper verifier self-test completed before runner delegation
preserved runner reported control_tree_clean=false and rejected Preflight

root_cause.proven_fact: The control tree was clean immediately before wrapper invocation and dirty when the preserved runner performed its clean-tree invariant after wrapper-side checks.
root_cause.leading_mechanism: The wrapper invokes the Python verifier self-test immediately before runner delegation. The verifier imports sibling snapshots via importlib and the repository .gitignore does not ignore Python __pycache__ or *.pyc. The historical classification does not depend on this mechanism being the only possible side effect.

prospective_correction: Run wrapper-side Python verifier self-tests with bytecode generation disabled and assert git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all is unchanged and clean before and after wrapper-side self-tests before runner delegation.
